q1_issues.issue: The sealed complement (Draw lantern nightmoth) silently drops both comparative qualifiers - "weaker" lanterns and "fewer" nightmoths - turning an unencodable covariation into an unqualified kind-level claim that lanterns draw nightmoths, which Core patterns forbids ("an unencodable qualifier never becomes an unqualified assertion").

The kind-level-relation route is not triggered here: it requires both arguments to be bare kind-denoting NPs, and an adjectivally-restricted kind subject ("weaker lanterns") is explicitly routed to the distributing-rule form instead.

(Leave nightmoth silken_thread) likewise drops "fewer" on both arguments, asserting inside the seal that nightmoths leave silken threads rather than the stated proportional covariation, and again takes the barred kind-relation route.
(Yield silken_thread mire_essence) drops "fewer" and "less", asserting inside the seal a plain kind relation the sentence does not state.

q2_gaps: Generic covariation stated with elided-standard comparatives / comparative quantifiers on both arguments ("weaker lanterns draw fewer nightmoths", "fewer nightmoths leave fewer silken threads", "fewer silken threads yield less mire-essence"): the comparative-correlative rule requires the "the ADJ-er X, the ADJ-er Y" surface, the attributive/elided-standard comparative rule says to drop the comparative and record a gap, and "fewer/less N" as a bare generic NP has no quantifier carrier (QuantifierPhrase covers proportion words, CardinalityPhrase needs a specific group), so the claim these three sentences actually make has no licensed form at all.
notes: Draw / Leave / Yield are lexical kind-relation heads that the relational-generic construction licenses in principle, so they are reported under q1 (wrong construction for these restricted arguments) rather than as invented heads. The attitude scaffolding is otherwise correct throughout - Experiencer holder, Recipient addressee, sealed Theme, past tense and Day/Year/midnight terms, definite typing and compound-decomposition atoms projected at top level, and the indefinite "a closed loop" kept inside the seal.
